name: LaMP-QA
description: LaMP-QA is a benchmark designed for evaluating personalized long-form answer generation in question answering systems. It covers questions from Arts & Entertainment, Lifestyle & Personal Development, and Society & Culture, with over 45 subcategories. The benchmark supports evaluation of personalized context incorporation in answer generation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far, but it is positioned as a useful testbed for personalized long-form QA evaluation.
notes: Focuses on personalized long-form QA with human and automatic evaluation; publicly released.
